notes.title: AI Update - v0.1.14.14-ea
notes.notes:
We're moving our release date up to Tuesdays to improve our ability to respond to feedback on time and fix bugs as they arise! In this build, we've made significant overhauls to the AI bots in the game, affecting not only their competitiveness but also their stability:

- Improved bot stability and fixed bugs related to stuck cases
- Overhaul of bot behavior system to be data-driven
- Bots are now more competitive
- Added new cloning effect for Invaders
- Invaders no longer try to target players in the repair state

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Big Update v0.1.14.13-ea
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Friday![/b]

Today we’ve released a pretty big update with many changes and improvements we’ve made to the game over the last 2 months.  These are some of the more significant and visible changes to the game:

[list]
[*] Improved Japanese localization.
[*] The turn timer is now 60 seconds and always visible.
[*] Cards that are not purchasable are now grayed out.
[*] We have worked to speed up gameplay in several ways.
[*] We adjusted the progression of the score multiplier over the match.
[*] You no longer lose your entire multiplier when you are shot or attacked.
[*] We made several tweaks to make the Invaders more challenging. 
[*] Invader clones and reinforcements will more rarely spawn very low and very high level cards.
[*] The bots now play significantly faster and are much more of a challenge to beat.
[*] Fixed issues with Time Warp, Materialize, and Scrap Collector cards.
[*] Fixed issue with auto-buy not working correctly in the store.
[*] We now show all player score multipliers on the score board.
[*] Improved card hovering behaviors.
[*] Fixed issue with scoreboard not setting hand count correctly.
[*] Cards are no longer selectable in the store if you cannot buy them.
[*] Cards get bigger when hovered in the store.
[*] Made the multiplier pulse while in a "loss" state.
[*] Hold to skip tutorial no longer ends turn.
[*] Hovered cards now can't get stuck in the enabled state.
[/list]

Moving forward we have plans for more core game improvements as well as some additional effects around combat and card play.  This is all in the efforts to finalize the 1.0 version of the game for release on Switch and PlayStation 5 in the summer.

Thanks for playing!

  [b]Sickhead Team[/b]

notes.title: CHANGELIST v0.1.14.0-ea
notes.notes:
Introducing a new card, Time Warp! It allows you to play an action card twice for free!

Gameplay Improvements
- New card! Time Warp, play an action from your hand twice.
- There is a minimum round time per Time Warp play.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed Time Warp issues with remote clients.
- Fixed issue with the wrong card count in the scoreboard.
- Fixed issue with the wrong card count in the draw pile.
- Fixed issues when leaving a match.
- Fixed issue with no cards in hand preventing end turn.
- Fixed issue with Replicator and validation of hand size.
- Breakthrough and Replicator now wait for the store in certain contexts.
- Fixed issue with additionals not resetting correctly after being credited.

notes.title: CHANGELIST v0.1.13.4-ea
notes.notes:
This week, we continued our work on card issues, and we expect results in the next build. However, we listened to your feedback and implemented a new experimental feature with invader shooting. Your feedback is essential to provide the best user experience for all players!

Gameplay Improvements
- ([i]WIP[/i]) Invaders will now alert you before they fire.

Thanks!

notes.title: CHANGELIST v0.1.13.2-ea
notes.notes:
This week we focused on UI and stability issues. Next week our plan is to tackle card issues.

UI Improvements
- Options menu icon now visible in game lobby
- Options menu sliders now have gamepad support
- Added Discord icon navigation on main menu
- Added button that can skip the tutorial (hold down to skip)
- Added gamepad support for viewing profile information page for Steam

Graphics Improvements
- Default to VSync on (Should improve frame stability for users)

Bug Fixes
- Fixed non-Latin characters in leaderboard not displaying properly
- Fixed network status from displaying properly on main menu
- Fixed lag spike when loading tutorials

Thanks!
